profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Full-stack software engineer with thirteen years of experience. I've worked with small development teams to implement and test full-stack applications and communicated with client-facing teams to determine developer requirements.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software Engineer 2
+ Integrated full-stack implementation of client-facing datatables, including features such as completion status tracking and data entry validation across a set of webforms.
+ Developed and tested client features based in java and javascript such as POST-form validations and data-integrity checks.
+ Built and maintained MYSQL database tables, views, and processes for webforms and data integrity.
+ Updated client-facing UI and UX for improved accessibility and readability.

Staff Engineer
+ Refactored solution codebase for improved stability and performance with Java Spring-Hibernate.
+ Improved client-facing UI and UX functionality based on javascript and bootstrap.
+ Maintained developer and production databases built within MySQL. 

Software Developer
+ Implemented, integrated, and tested software features for client-facing products built in Java.
+ Maintained and updated client software solutions built in Java.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
As a software developer at Tokio Marine Technologies, my primary responsibility was maintaining application that relied heavily on Microsoft CRM and SQL databases.  In addition, I maintained and incorporated new features into an application relying on the .NET framework and ASP.net, and provided support for production and QA.

The primary technologies I used in this position include the .NET framework, github, Visual Studio 2012/2013/2015, Sql Server Management Studio, and JIRA.  The languages I primarily used are C# and Javascript.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
As a software engineer at Kaneva, I was responsible for developing a blueprint system to be integrated with existing game systems and a crowding AI for enemy characters.  In addition, I integrated new game assets into the Kaneva platform and new UI elements into existing menus.  

The primary technologies I used in this position were TFS 2010 and the lua programming language.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
As a software developer at MetalForming Inc, I was responsible for developing an existing transportation and distribution application to stable condition.  I also developed a material bundling app designed to integrate a standalone transportation app into existing company software, and designed a UI and reports for the transportation app.  

The primary technologies I used were the .NET framework, Visual Studio 2010, TFS2010, and the C# programming language.

positions.title: Undergraduate Researcher
positions.description: I researched scene generation for virtual environments under Professor Mark Riedl.  By the end of the semester, I had coded a system based in Unity that was capable of populating a scene with assets based on common object relations.  This was developed using the Unity3d engine in C# and xml.

positions.title: Undergraduate Researcher
positions.description: I developed a transportation system for the Ellis Island Project under Professor Celia Pearce.  This transportation system simulated boat transportation and was based on user-designed maps where points of interest were specified by nodes.  This was developed using the Unity3D engine in C#.

positions.title: Undergraduate Researcher
positions.description: I researched integration methods for a computer vision algorithm designed for robot learning under Professor Andrea Thomaz.  In addition, I restored online functionality to the robot learning project, Sophie's Kitchen.  This research was done in the Linux environment.

volunteerExperiences.description:

Prototyped a surface-creeping scene asset for Mermaids Project
Debugged and commented C# code
Converted Unity javascript code to C# code

projects.title: Accessible Scene Generator (Alpha-build)
projects.description:
This is a project that I started on at the beginning of my Spring 2013 semester.  The goal is to create a scene generator that will be accessible to non-experienced users and in the long term, generate scenes based on user specifications and with resources from a knowledgebase.  The system generates a scene based on a list of spatial relations such as one object being on top of another object or two objects positioned next to each other. These relations are used to generate and position the desired assets on the scene following a constraint satisfaction algorithm.

This is an ongoing project within the Entertainment Intelligence Lab.

projects.title: Siege Defense
projects.description:
Siege Defense is a simple physics-based game designed in Unity3D.  The player is tasked with building a protective wall of various blocks to defend a king from a siege cannon.

This was a project for Computer Animation taken in Spring 2013 at Georgia Institute of Technology.
